query:
SELECT
                    task_id,
                    kind::text as "kind!",
                    duration_sec,
                    comment,
                    source,
                    te.created_at
                FROM telemetry_events te
                JOIN plans p ON te.task_id = ANY(
                    SELECT id FROM plan_tasks WHERE plan_id = p.id
                )
                WHERE p.home_id = $1
                ORDER BY te.created_at DESC
                LIMIT 50
